The 3fc2883 fix resolved the first run's assertion-2 failure: no finding at any severity keys B2 or B3, group B is 'Pass', and the scoped step-4 nudge is explicitly credited as 'the B3 pattern, so the B2 carve-out applies'. The advisory A20/C1 Low about the missing `effort:` field is ruled a frontmatter-consistency note, not a flag on the nudge — both of its fixes keep the nudge scoped — but it is the one residual route by which the fixture's scoping clause still draws comment.
